commands:
set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; TMP=$(mktemp -d); SERVER_PID=''; TUNNEL_PID=''; cleanup(){ if [ -n "$TUNNEL_PID" ]; then kill "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if [ -n "$SERVER_PID" ]; then kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; python3 -m http.server 18765 --bind 127.0.0.1 >"$TMP/server.log" 2>&1 & SERVER_PID=$!; cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate --url http://127.0.0.1:18765 >"$TMP/tunnel.out" 2>"$TMP/tunnel.err" & TUNNEL_PID=$!; URL=''; for i in $(seq 1 120); do URL=$(grep -Eo 'https://[a-z0-9-]+[.]trycloudflare[.]com' "$TMP/tunnel.err" | head -n 1 || true); [ -n "$URL" ] && break; if ! kill -0 "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null; then echo tunnel_exited=true; tail -40 "$TMP/tunnel.err"; exit 1; fi; sleep 0.25; done; test -n "$URL"; echo quick_tunnel_url_published=true; HOST=${URL#https://}; python3 - "$HOST" <<'PY'
import socket,sys,time
host=sys.argv[1]
for attempt in range(12):
    try:
        addrs=socket.getaddrinfo(host,443,type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        print('dns_resolved=true')
        print('dns_address_count='+str(len(addrs)))
        break
    except OSError as e:
        print('dns_attempt_failed='+type(e).__name__)
        time.sleep(5)
else:
    print('dns_resolved=false')
PY
REACH=0; LAST=''; for i in $(seq 1 12); do set +e; LAST=$(curl -sS -o "$TMP/body" -w '%{http_code}' --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 "$URL/" 2>"$TMP/curl.err"); RC=$?; set -e; echo https_attempt_$i=rc_${RC}_http_${LAST}; if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ] && [ "$LAST" = 200 ]; then REACH=1; break; fi; sleep 5; done; echo https_reachable=$REACH; if [ "$REACH" -ne 1 ]; then echo cloudflared_tail_begin; tail -30 "$TMP/tunnel.err"; echo cloudflared_tail_end; echo curl_error_begin; cat "$TMP/curl.err"; echo curl_error_end; exit 1; fi; grep -q 'Directory listing' "$TMP/body"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo quick_tunnel_diagnostics_green=true
